name: Boston Celtics
notes: The Boston Celtics play in the Atlantic Division of the NBA's Eastern Conference, with home games at TD Garden in Boston. They are the most decorated franchise in NBA history, having won a record 18 championships, most recently in 2024. Entering the 2026-27 season the roster is anchored by Jayson Tatum, with Paul George newly acquired via a July 2026 trade that sent longtime co-star Jaylen Brown to the Philadelphia 76ers.

roster.facts: Boston's undisputed franchise cornerstone since the July 2026 Jaylen Brown trade, Tatum returned from a torn Achilles months ahead of the typical recovery timeline.
roster.name: Jayson Tatum

roster.facts: Acquired from Philadelphia in the July 2026 trade for Jaylen Brown, George joins as Boston's new co-star after a 25-game drug-test suspension.
roster.name: Paul George

roster.facts: Named to the 2025-26 NBA All-Defensive First Team with career-high 98 blocks, White is now Boston's clear second option behind Tatum.
roster.name: Derrick White

roster.facts: The reigning 2024-25 Sixth Man of the Year, Pritchard remains a fan-favorite spark plug and is extension-eligible starting October 1, 2026.
roster.name: Payton Pritchard

roster.facts: Boston's breakout starting center in 2025-26 — 10.2 points, 8.4 rebounds, 65.3% shooting — Queta just signed a four-year, $56 million extension.
roster.name: Neemias Queta

roster.facts: Signed away from the Knicks on a three-year, $47.4 million deal, Robinson shares starting center minutes with Queta despite a lengthy injury history.
roster.name: Mitchell Robinson

roster.facts: Boston's top movement shooter, Hauser is locked into a four-year, $45 million extension running through the 2028-29 season as a rotation stretch wing.
roster.name: Sam Hauser

roster.facts: The 38-year-old, 20-year veteran signed a one-year minimum deal as backup point guard and locker-room mentor to Boston's young guards.
roster.name: Mike Conley

roster.facts: A plus perimeter defender who earned a three-year, $15 million extension in July 2026, Walsh is set for an expanded bench role.
roster.name: Jordan Walsh

roster.facts: Now in year two, Scheierman started 20 games in 2025-26, hit a career-high 30 points, and posted the team's best 3-point percentage.
roster.name: Baylor Scheierman

roster.facts: Boston's 2025 first-round pick out of Real Madrid, González posted the best plus-minus of any rookie last season and is already viewed as a draft steal.
roster.name: Hugo González

roster.facts: Boston's backup big man led all centers in 3-point shooting in 2025-26 at 43.3%, giving the Celtics a stretch option off the bench.
roster.name: Luka Garza

roster.facts: Converted from a two-way deal to a standard contract in April 2026, Harper Jr. then locked in a three-year, $9 million extension in June.
roster.name: Ron Harper Jr.

roster.facts: Boston's 2026 first-round pick (27th overall), Cenac Jr. enters as a rookie big man on a four-year, $15.3 million rookie-scale contract.
roster.name: Chris Cenac Jr.

roster.facts: A 2025 second-round pick and the first British-born Celtic, Williams is a two-way center developing his game between Boston and the Maine G League affiliate.
roster.name: Amari Williams
